notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another nontoken creature without summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite mana creatures you control can produce.
